# sapintegrationsuite_script_collection (Data Source)

Reads an existing reusable Cloud Integration script collection's metadata by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sapintegrationsuite_script_collection" "shared" {
  package_id           = "UTILITIES"
  script_collection_id = "shared-scripts"
}

output "shared_script_collection_version" {
  value = data.sapintegrationsuite_script_collection.shared.version
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `package_id` (String) ID of the integration package the script collection belongs to.
- `script_collection_id` (String) The script collection's technical ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite identifier in the form "<package_id>/<script_collection_id>".
- `name` (String) The script collection's display name.
- `version` (String) The design-time version SAP reports for this script collection.
